ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a three-dimensional cross-shaped solid made from unit cubes. There is one unit cube at the center, and another six unit cubes are respectively attached to its six faces, extending upward, downward, leftward, rightward, forward, and backward, so there are 7 unit cubes in total. Reasoning: The volume of each unit cube is 1, so the total volume is 7. When finding the surface area, the 6 faces of the central cube are all covered by the outer cubes, therefore there are no exposed faces. Each outer cube has only 1 face connected to the central cube, and the remaining 5 faces are exposed. There are 6 outer cubes in total, so the surface area is 6 × 5 = 30. The ratio of volume to surface area is 7 : 30.

raw_record.question_text: A shape is created by joining seven unit cubes, as shown. What is the ratio of the volume in cubic units to the surface area in square units?

method.method_draft: First describe the pictured solid as a 3D cross: one central unit cube has six unit cubes attached to its six faces, visible as cubes extending upward, downward, left, right, forward, and backward, for seven cubes total. From the text, the volume is the volume of seven unit cubes, so volume = 7 cubic units. For surface area, use the image structure: the central cube contributes no exposed faces because each of its 6 faces is covered by an attached cube. Each of the 6 outer cubes has exactly 1 face glued to the central cube and 5 exposed faces. Thus surface area = 6 × 5 = 30 square units. The requested ratio of volume to surface area is 7 : 30.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个由单位立方体拼成的三维十字形立体。中心有一个单位立方体，另外六个单位立方体分别接在它的六个面上，向上、向下、向左、向右、向前、向后伸出，所以总共有 7 个单位立方体。

推理：每个单位立方体体积为 1，所以总体积为 7。求表面积时，中心立方体的 6 个面都被外侧立方体盖住，因此没有外露面。每个外侧立方体只有 1 个面与中心立方体相接，剩下 5 个面外露。共有 6 个外侧立方体，所以表面积为 6 × 5 = 30。体积与表面积的比为 7 : 30。
